design_decisions.title: web_host_bootstrap
design_decisions.rationale: Create the standard Flutter Web host only when the existing app bootstrap and plugin graph can compile safely for Web.
constraints: Create apps/flutter_forge/web using the repository's existing Flutter app identity and bootstrap conventions; do not create a second application or nested MaterialApp.
Preserve Android/macOS/Windows host behavior and do not add iOS or Linux hosts.
Web must use in-app navigation and must not initialize desktop_multi_window or any native desktop window API.
Do not add secrets, signing configuration, release publishing, or CI release artifacts in this task.

design_decisions.title: web_capability_matrix
design_decisions.rationale: Each capability requires an actual Web implementation or an explicit unavailable/degraded state; package transitive Web support alone is insufficient.
constraints: Evaluate WebView, online video, file picker and gcode_visualizer independently.
Use kIsWeb or TargetPlatform only at the existing platform boundary seams; do not add scattered platform checks across unrelated modules.

WebView may be marked supported only if a concrete Web backend is implemented and the Web build/test path exercises it; otherwise expose a visible unavailable/degraded state and keep metadata planned.

online_video_player may be marked supported only if video_player_web behavior is implemented/tested with the existing lifecycle safety; otherwise keep it planned or degraded without importing video_player_win on Web.
file_picker may be marked supported only if file_selector_web is reachable and tested; otherwise expose a visible unavailable state instead of falling back to MethodChannel on Web.
gcode_visualizer remains not_target on Web unless the external gcode_core contract and Flutter GPU requirements are proven compatible by the task; do not weaken the macOS-only GPU boundary.

design_decisions.title: generated_contract_and_acceptance_truth
design_decisions.rationale: Keep generated agent documents, runtime platform behavior and acceptance evidence synchronized without promoting planned Web work to support.
constraints: Modify tool/generate_agent_indexes.js as the source of generated metadata, then regenerate all protected documents.
Use supportedPlatforms only for capabilities actually implemented and tested on Web; use the existing planned work-queue mechanism for incomplete capability work.
Keep iOS and Linux out of active target/support lists for this task.
Update maintained Web documentation/evidence only with results actually produced by commands; do not fabricate browser or GUI acceptance.
Do not modify Agent Hub source, registry-report.md, benchmark cases or architecture goldens in this task.

implementation_steps.detail: Re-check git status, branch tracking, HEAD/origin refs, inspect pending .hermes task files, read AGENTS.md, AI_ANALYSIS_SCHEMA.json, AI_PROJECT_CONTEXT.md, REFACTOR_PLAN.md, tool/generate_agent_indexes.js, WebView/video/file-picker seams and existing tests. Stop if the baseline moved or unrelated changes exist.
Create the standard apps/flutter_forge/web host and make the existing app bootstrap compile for Web. Keep desktop_multi_window disabled on Web and preserve NavigationPolicy in-app behavior.

Implement only the minimal Web capability adapters needed for a truthful build: WebView, online video and file picker must each either work through a concrete Web package/backend or render an explicit unavailable/degraded state. Keep gcode_visualizer macOS-only and USB Android-only.

Add focused Web-aware unit/widget tests for navigation policy, module availability, WebView fallback/backend selection, file picker selection, video adapter platform safety and compact Web layout. Tests must run on the available host without requiring a browser GUI; add a browser integration test only if the repository's installed Flutter toolchain supports it.

Update tool/generate_agent_indexes.js only for source-of-truth metadata and planned/implemented Web facts. Run bash tool/generate_harness_ai_analysis.sh and verify AI_MODULE_INDEX, route table, AI_ANALYSIS.md and AI_PROJECT_CONTEXT.md are regenerated without hand edits or drift.

Run node --check tool/generate_agent_indexes.js, node tool/validate_agent_docs.js, bash tool/check_generated_docs.sh, dart format ., flutter analyze, bash tool/test_all.sh, bash tool/verify_test_layout.sh, and the Web build/test commands supported by the installed Flutter SDK. Run bash tool/quality_gate.sh after the intended changes are staged.

Write or update a tracked Web integration report with exact command results and explicit PASS/PENDING/BLOCKED/NOT_IN_ARTIFACT boundaries. Inspect the complete diff, stage only Forge Web implementation/tests/generated outputs/report/task JSON, create one local commit with message feat(web): add Flutter Forge web platform baseline, then verify git show, git status, HEAD and origin/dev. Do not push.
